prompts.groupHeader: Create a NEW production UI COMPONENT using the attached frame only as a material/style reference. One very slim horizontal cyberpunk group-header / disclosure rail, brushed titanium and dark gunmetal, intricate tiny machined bevels, micro screws, narrow icy cyan light channels and a few violet micro accents. This is the component itself, NOT a scene, wallpaper, hero, screenshot or mockup. Ultra-wide rectangular front-on orthographic silhouette, target visible aspect 9:1, tightly cropped transparent canvas. Small chamfered EMPTY square icon recess on the left ~12% width, a broad completely empty nearly-black/navy quiet text recess from x17%-82%, an integrated empty small right recess for a native chevron at x86%-95%. Keep artwork thin and restrained, tiny top/bottom rails, no bulky antennas or projecting decorations. Horizontal center rails from x25%-75% must be STRAIGHT and uniform at constant vertical positions so they can crop/repeat without seams. Accurate transparent cut corners, no opaque canvas outside chassis. No text, letters, numbers, icons, logos, characters, buildings, scenery. Detailed premium illustrated mechanical UI matching reference's material quality. Preserve large usable native text region, display at 30px high so emphasize clean edges rather than clutter.
prompts.hangarDeck: Create a NEW production transparent UI COMPONENT matching attached cyberpunk frame materials, not a background scene. A wide, very slim horizontal companion hangar PLATFORM / DECK, front-on orthographic with a tiny visible top surface, target visible aspect 10:1. Brushed titanium, silver/gunmetal bevels, layered machined edge, tiny restrained cyan light channel across front lip, few violet indicator strips, subtle bolts and vents confined to endcaps. No walls or canopy, no backdrop, no characters, no shadows outside object, no text or logos. Empty flat upper landing surface on which native animated mascots will stand. Absolutely straight, uniform repeatable center section x20%-80%; mechanical chamfered fixed endcaps at left and right. Alpha transparent around silhouette and above deck. Closely fitted transparent canvas. Design to be seen at24px high and stretched horizontally by clipping/repeating its quiet center; no large center emblem, no diagonals traversing middle. Component itself is richly illustrated artwork, not a poster or rendered room. Refined and polished, precise clean hard edges, no blurry glow bloom.
